articles.headline: Tyler Ankrum wins Craftsman 200 (Championship Race)
articles.dek: Official finish, points and how the championship looks after the race.
articles.body:
Tyler Ankrum won Craftsman 200 (Championship Race) at Homestead-Miami Speedway, starting P2 and leading 122 laps. Cole Butcher finished second and Daniel Hemric was third.

The race ran 200 laps with 6 cautions.

Daniel Hemric was the biggest mover, gaining 15 spots from P18 to P3.

Dallas Underwood leads the championship with 954 points, 44 ahead of Chandler Smith.
articles.author: Jamie Kowalski
